run_bop24_pose_evaluation: run the BOP24 pose evaluation script on LMO and TLESS dataset results
run_bop24_pose_evaluation_with_false_pos: run the BOP24 pose evaluation with injected false positive dummy estimates
load_bop_results: load BOP pose estimation results from a CSV file using inout.load_bop_results
save_bop_results: save BOP pose estimation results to a CSV file using inout.save_bop_results
